name: io.github.walma-labs/gsc-mcp
description: Read-only Google Search Console MCP server with service-account auth: search analytics, period comparison, sitemaps and URL inspection.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service-account JSON key (or set GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON with the key inline)

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: The service-account key as inline JSON (alternative to the file path)
